SHENSHEN-FORM_POWER.title: Girl Form
SHENSHEN-FORM_POWER.description: Draw from your owned girl deck. Transformation changes form without resetting resources or powers.
SHENSHEN-FORM_POWER.catDescription: Draw from your owned cat deck. Transformation changes form without resetting resources or powers.
SHENSHEN-FORM_POWER.smartDescription: Girl and cat form use separate owned card cycles. Transformation preserves resources and powers.
SHENSHEN-FORM_SHIFT_POWER.title: Transformation Echo
SHENSHEN-FORM_SHIFT_POWER.description: You transformed this turn. Claw Strike hits 4 times. Removed before your next normal hand draw.
SHENSHEN-FORM_SHIFT_POWER.smartDescripti: You transformed this turn. Claw Strike hits 4 times. Removed before your next normal hand draw.
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_MARK_POWER.title: Light Mark
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_MARK_POWER.description:
Each hit from the applier's attacks deals {BurnDamage} extra burn damage.
{Turns} of the applier's turns remain. Burn is blocked normally, ignores Strength and Vulnerable, and cannot trigger Light Mark.
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_MARK_POWER.smartDescripti: Each hit from the applier's attacks deals fixed extra burn damage, blocked normally. Duration decreases at the start of the applier's subsequent turns.
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_BLESSING_POWER.title: Light Blessing
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_BLESSING_POWER.descriptio: Before your next normal draw, choose {Amount} extra cards from your draw pile to add to hand.
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_BLESSING_POWER.smartDescr: Before your next normal draw, choose {Amount} extra cards from your draw pile to add to hand.
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_BLESSING_POWER.selectionS: Choose {Amount} extra cards to add to hand.
SHENSHEN-CAT_DODGE_POWER.title: Cat Dodge
SHENSHEN-CAT_DODGE_POWER.description:
Ready. While in cat form, dodge the first hit of the first enemy multi-hit attack this turn. Single-hit attacks cannot be dodged.
The dodged hit consumes no Block and triggers no Thorns or reflection. Refreshes before your next normal draw; transformation does not refresh it.
SHENSHEN-CAT_DODGE_POWER.usedDescription: Used this turn. Cat dodge refreshes before your next normal draw; transformation does not refresh it.
SHENSHEN-CAT_DODGE_POWER.smartDescriptio: While in cat form, dodge the first hit of the first enemy multi-hit attack this turn, without consuming Block or triggering retaliation. Refreshes before your next normal draw.
SHENSHEN-FLUFFED_UP_POWER.title: Fluffed Up
SHENSHEN-FLUFFED_UP_POWER.description:
After activation, gain 3 Thorns the first time you lose HP to an enemy attack this combat. No further growth.
The reward never resets with turns or transformation. Debuffs, self-damage, poison damage, and status cards do not trigger it.
SHENSHEN-FLUFFED_UP_POWER.smartDescripti: After activation, gain 3 Thorns on the first enemy attack hit that causes HP loss this combat. No further growth; the reward can occur only once this combat.
SHENSHEN-FLUFFED_UP_POWER.upgradedDescri:
After activation, the first enemy attack that causes actual HP loss this combat grants 3 Thorns. Each later hit that causes HP loss grants 1.
Each different debuff successfully applied by an enemy grants another 1 Thorns without using the first-hit reward.
The first-hit reward never resets with turns or transformation. Self-damage, poison damage, and status cards do not trigger it.
SHENSHEN-SHATTERED_MIRROR_POWER.title: Shattered Mirror
SHENSHEN-SHATTERED_MIRROR_POWER.descript: {Amount} mirror Block remains. Only this portion of Block reflects the attack damage it absorbs. Other Block does not increase it. Expires at your next turn.
SHENSHEN-SHATTERED_MIRROR_POWER.smartDes: {Amount} mirror Block remains. Only this portion of Block reflects the attack damage it absorbs. Other Block does not increase it. Expires at your next turn.
SHENSHEN-TEMPORARY_DEXTERITY_POWER.title: Temporary Dexterity
SHENSHEN-TEMPORARY_DEXTERITY_POWER.descr: Lose the {Amount} temporary Dexterity before your next normal draw. Permanent Dexterity remains.
SHENSHEN-TEMPORARY_DEXTERITY_POWER.smart: Lose the {Amount} temporary Dexterity before your next normal draw. Permanent Dexterity remains.
SHENSHEN-TEMPORARY_THORNS_POWER.title: Temporary Thorns
SHENSHEN-TEMPORARY_THORNS_POWER.descript: Lose the {Amount} temporary Thorns before your next normal draw. Permanent Thorns remain.
SHENSHEN-TEMPORARY_THORNS_POWER.smartDes: Lose the {Amount} temporary Thorns before your next normal draw. Permanent Thorns remain.
SHENSHEN-CURIOUS_PEEK_POWER.title: Curious Echo
SHENSHEN-CURIOUS_PEEK_POWER.description: After your next transformation this turn, draw {Amount} additional card(s) from your new form. Expires at the end of this turn if unused.
SHENSHEN-CURIOUS_PEEK_POWER.smartDescrip: After your next transformation this turn, draw {Amount} additional card(s) from your new form. Expires at the end of this turn if unused.
SHENSHEN-CATNAP_POWER.title: Catnap
SHENSHEN-CATNAP_POWER.description: Gain {Amount} additional Energy before your next normal draw.
SHENSHEN-CATNAP_POWER.smartDescription: Gain {Amount} additional Energy before your next normal draw.
